selection: Allowed facts/issues only for coverage; retain saved rank within mechanism; deterministic round robin, seed 20261004 for train/test separation; never verdict, target reasoning, previous model outputs or predicted gain
candidate_input: Existing SQLite cases and previously saved candidate records; regex hits are screening only
source_separation: Source-case authority must not leak own/related target final reasoning into inputs; unknown relations marked
labels: Coarse case-specific authority use, with original source IDs; unknown/unreviewed excluded, not negative; no pairwise labels or new fine schemas
test_policy: Reserve before main method freeze; no test labels/features/ranking feedback used to develop method; sealed contents excluded from review/publication
main_training: Only S/B/C after sufficient usable 30 train and frozen authority pool; V08 architecture/settings unchanged, no C0/no tuning
decision_order: B>S with stable material benefit? else pause graph
C>B with stable material and full answer benefit? else keep simple model
